title: Two movement keys in the same tick: first pressed key wins instead of last
observed: Seed 12345, one tick with down+right from the start (1,1): the player ends at (1,2), so the down key was applied and the right key was ignored. In run 2, right+down also moved right to (2,1), so the earlier key wins in both orders.
expected: Design section 2/3: of the movement keys pressed in a tick, only the last one counts. down+right should move the player right to (2,1).
